## Current signals

- WebNR remains a local-first browser reader and may be described as an independent browser-based alternative for some Legado users and web-first reading workflows. It is unaffiliated with Legado and is not an official Legado web client. Arbitrary Legado source JSON is not yet a drop-in WebNR runtime; compatibility claims remain tied to tested capability levels and versioned fixtures.
- `https://www.webnovel.win/` is the sole canonical public identity for documentation, reader-facing articles, search indexing, canonical tags, sitemap, and RSS. `https://app.webnovel.win/` is the reader application runtime; `https://autoarchive.github.io/webNR/` is an attributable documentation build mirror only.
- Pull request #120 expands `Fanfiction Discovery Starter` to eight audited first-party discovery destinations: FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, Scribble Hub, Archive of Our Own (AO3), SquidgeWorld, fanfiction.lol, Sunset, and Asianfanfics. The shipped capability remains static link-only: WebNR stores destination URLs plus WebNR-authored descriptions/labels and does not crawl, poll, proxy, mirror, download, automate accounts, bypass access controls, or copy origin works, story metadata, covers, ratings, comments, bookmarks, or story text.
- The 2026-08-27 source program screened Asianfanfics, Quotev, FictionPress, MediaMiner, and Honeyfeed. Asianfanfics, FictionPress, and Honeyfeed received complete bounded audits; Asianfanfics shipped as the passing integration. Quotev remains deferred because current first-party policy text could not be reliably established in the operating environment, and MediaMiner remains deferred because sufficiently current first-party machine-access/terms evidence was not established. FictionPress and Honeyfeed are better candidates for original-fiction / English-serial lanes rather than the fanfiction-specific starter.
- AO3 remains admitted for first-party Work Search discovery. Official canonical-tag Atom feeds remain a richer machine-interface candidate, but WebNR does not yet claim Atom synchronization; runtime transport, stable identity, update semantics, response bounds, cadence, attribution, and versioned fixtures must be proven first.
- Fimfiction remains the strongest official-API upgrade candidate technically, but the 2026-08-27 audit identified a concrete external dependency. Current first-party developer documentation uses OAuth2 and current Application Management documentation says a new API application must presently be created by Fimfiction after contacting the site operator. WebNR has no registered Fimfiction application/client identity in the repository, so it must not claim a working API adapter or fabricate credentials. Once an application identity exists, implement bounded OAuth transport, rate-limit/backoff, caching, stable story identity, sparse fields, cursor pagination, response/timeout bounds, provenance, attribution, update/deletion semantics, and versioned fixtures.
- The currently accepted maintained source set is: WebNR Originals, Aozora Bunko Starter, Standard Ebooks Starter, Project Madurai Starter, English Serial Platforms Starter, Project Gutenberg Starter, Global Grey Starter, Online Books Page Starter, Wolne Lektury Starter, Wikisource Starter, English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter, Chinese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Japanese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter, and Fanfiction Discovery Starter. Rights/access behavior remains source-specific; several maintained catalogs are intentionally link-only at their current proven capability level.
- The deferred/source-audit queue still includes candidates such as Project Runeberg, StoryWeaver, Lit2Go, Perseus Digital Library, Baen Free Library, LitFic, Betakyte, Hungry's Hedgerow, Ream, Laterpress, Fanqie / 番茄小说, Changpei / 长佩文学, 潇湘书院, 红袖读书, SF轻小说 / 菠萝包轻小说, 刺猬猫, ハーメルン, Nolaノベル, ノベモア, ノベルアップ＋, pixiv novels, 카카오페이지 / KakaoPage, 조아라 / Joara, OneStory, Bookcube, MrBlue, Ascendant Reads, ProgFans, Royal Guard Publishing, The Legion Publishers, Twisting the Hellmouth, Ad Astra current-primary integration, CFAA, Quotev, and MediaMiner.
